args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (error rate ~18%, unhealthy in all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release, in all regions. Rollback verified (status rolled_out).

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was running `v2.3.1` in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an ~18% error rate.

2. **Identified the rollback target**: The deployment history showed `v2.3.0` was the most recent healthy production release (v2.3.1 was unhealthy, and v2.3.1-rc was a staging build).

3. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to `v2.3.0` in all production regions. The rollback was verified (`rolled_out`).

4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (`INC-0001`) describing the health-check failures after the v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0, which paged the on-call engineer.
